2024_143_oct_2024_pcard_report.paragraph: Monthly purchasing-card listing for Troy School District covering October 2024, headed "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, Oct 2024" and carried on the Board of Education agenda of December 17, 2024. Every line shares the journal-entry description "OCT 2024 PCARD EXP" and is itemized by transaction description, budget unit, account code, transaction amount and credits; printed transaction dates run from 9/26/2024 through 10/25/2024 across pages numbered 1 through 48, each footer-dated 12/11/2024. The listing closes with a Subtotal of 373,515.10 in charges and 9,481.15 in credits, and Total Expenses of 364,033.95. The largest single charge is 9,867.98 to B&H PHOTO MO on 10/16/2024, budget unit 423160284000000, account code 6410.
